statement: Community notes specify B2 A1 user-calibration markers at 0x8010/11 (left), 0x801B/1C (right), 0x8026/27 (IMU), with data at 0x8012..1A, 0x801D..25 and 0x8028..3F respectively. Linux and SDL use the markers to select user over factory data. OpenPuck synthesizes a mutable user SPI mirror.
